concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish reporting area recorded by land revenue records from geographical area measured by the Survey of India.
Identify the nine land-use categories maintained in the land revenue records.
Classify uncultivated land as current fallow, fallow other than current fallow or culturable wasteland by duration.
Explain how growth and changing composition of the economy affect land-use.
Interpret the increases and declines in land-use categories between 1950-51 and 2019-20.
Define common property resources and distinguish them from private land.
Explain the importance of CPRs for landless and marginal farmers and rural women.

topics.title: Agricultural Land Use and Cropping Intensity

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why land is more crucial to livelihoods dependent on agriculture than to other sectors.
Compute and interpret the total stock of cultivable land using Table 3.1.
Calculate cropping intensity and explain why a high cropping intensity suits India.

topics.title: Cropping Seasons and Types of Farming
topics.ncert_sections: Cropping Seasons in India; Types of Farming

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the kharif, rabi and zaid seasons and why they are not distinct in southern India.
Distinguish protective irrigation from productive irrigation.
Differentiate dryland farming from wetland farming by rainfall and crops.
Describe the distribution, conditions and yield patterns of rice, wheat and coarse cereals.
Explain the characteristics and distribution of pulses such as gram and tur.

topics.title: Oilseeds, Fibre Crops and Other Crops

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the main oilseed crops, their growing regions and leading states.
Describe the conditions and distribution of cotton and jute.
Explain the growing conditions and distribution of sugarcane, tea and coffee.

topics.title: Agricultural Development and Problems
topics.ncert_sections: Agricultural Development in India; Problems of Indian Agriculture

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the Green Revolution strategy and later agricultural planning in India.
Analyse problems such as erratic monsoon, low productivity, indebtedness and underemployment.
Explain how faulty irrigation and farming practices degrade cultivable land.
